reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model 200LQ, which is not on the recalled model list (200LX). Under the claim policy, a legible label showing a non-recalled model means the unit is not part of this recall, so the claim is denied. The typed model 200LQ matches the label reading and is likewise not recalled.
The serial number HA01694 is within the recalled range, but the serial check does not override the model finding; the unit is not a recalled model.
No duplicate claims were found, and the purchase date falls inside the sale window, so these checks do not change the outcome.
